name: rhiz
notes: Uses the site's own Copilot Events REST API (wp-json/copilot-promotion/v1/promotions), returned unpaginated in one call (12 upcoming shows at build time, spanning Sep-Dec 2026 - that's the site's real publishing horizon, not a horizon_days artifact). No structured price field; some descriptions mention door prices/donations in free text but that's not reliable enough to parse into price_min, so it stays null throughout. category is always null from this API. Detail URL is reconstructed as https://rhiz.wien/?copilot-slug=<slug> per the plugin's own JS routing.
